band.basis: Sum of cited components: slab composite (184-191, QV AKL 199/m2 adjusted for out-of-scope items) + SE92 mesh upgrade (27-33) + subgrade trim (11.1) + sawcut joints (0.9-1.2) + isolation joint (1.8) + spoil (1-2) + set-out (1-2). Midpoint $235/m2. 300 m2 total: $68,100 - $72,900 (midpoint $70,500). Excludes GST, prelims, margin, design/engineering/consent fees. Main drivers (concrete supply AKL $338/m3, GAP40 AKL $112/m3, slab composite, mesh, trim, sawcut) are all cited QV rows; allowances are under 2% of the total. Cross-check via External Works / In Situ Concrete Paving 150mm (QV AKL $144/m2, 17.5MPa) + 25MPa upgrade + mesh + subbase + trim lands in the same $215-240/m2 zone. Confidence is LOW because (a) QV's SE92 mesh rate ($52/m2) is a ~3x outlier versus the $15-19/m2 assumed in the scenario and carries ~$30/m2 of the band, and (b) the slab composite is an internal slab-on-grade rate used as a proxy for external paving, with inclusion adjustments by judgement. If a market mesh rate (~$20/m2) is substituted, the band falls to roughly $195-210/m2.

Sum of 11 distinct components: subgrade trim/level to falls, cart spoil, 150mm GAP40, 150mm 25MPa concrete placed/screeded/finished (composite QV rate + 25MPa premium), SE92 mesh, edge formwork, sawcut joints, isolation joint, pump, set-out allowance, curing. 300 m2 total = $45,300-$53,100; midpoint $164/m2 = $49,200. No component is counted twice: the concrete composite rate already carries supply+place+finish, so no separate concrete or placing line was added; mesh is excluded from that rate because QV states no kg/m3. Confidence low because (a) QV's mesh rate ($52/m2) is the largest line and may be supply-only or small-area-priced - a market check at ~$20-25/m2 installed would pull the band to ~$125-150/m2; (b) if the $479/m3 concrete rate already includes mesh, deduct component 5. QV rates are unreviewed and generally sit above tendered market. Not a certified price.

Sum of the 16 components above, Auckland QV CostBuilder rates (unreviewed) plus labelled allowances, GST exclusive, subcontract rate. 300 m2 total $48,200-$55,400 (centre $51,800). Main cost drivers all cited: concrete supply, SE92 mesh, GAP40 subbase, finishing labours, joints, pump. Confidence low because (a) QV publishes no separate concrete-placing rate and the placing allowance of $3-12/m2 is judgement, and QV's all-in slab/paving rows imply a ceiling nearer $230/m2 if their embedded overhead content is retained; (b) the spec's 'SE92 mesh (665 grade)' is self-conflicting and swings the mesh line by ~$32/m2; (c) the edge-formwork row is a tilt-panel proxy. Allowances carry ~5-12% of the total, under a third.
